text: You see, this is a moment of… you know, every time we look back on this moment
when we signed this agreement which severed
Singapore from Malaysia, it would be a moment of anguish.
I mean, for me, it is a moment of anguish because all my life…
You see, the whole of my adult life…
I had believed in Malays— in merger
and the unity of these two territories.
connected by geography, economics and ties of kinship…
Would you mind if we stop for a while?
